reason: The finding is factually right, and the fix is cheap and within the rules. It is not a new mechanism: it only makes rows of the 16:08Z pre-registered W1 card executable. FACTS (18:13-18:25Z): experiments/ holds only exp76a_k2fm_coordinject and exp76d_k2fm_secft. exp73m has no dummy output and no CONTEXT dummy line. At the poll header 18:04:40Z, 45 (56606948) and 46 (56611472) are both PENDING. FEASIBILITY: I rebuilt everything in a scratch ROOT (repo untouched) with builder d46a8b2d and coordinject_patch 78cae2a9. exp70b b8e7ece1, exp70q 33ab04d1, exp76a 98a9e647 and exp73m 76c81122 match the repo byte for byte. The draft names reproduce the round-18 shas (exp76c 1bb648a4, exp76e d5c5ff5e, exp76g 17bf5872). The notebook diffs are clean. exp76e vs exp70b: DIVINS_CAP 4->6 plus the name, nothing else. exp76g vs exp70q: the two SECONDARY env lines plus the secft dataset. exp76c vs exp70q: the two COORDINJECT lines, a CI cell whose text is identical to exp76a's (the dummy passed on exp75), and the coord-inject dataset. All stages are byte-identical when off and fail-soft, as already verified on exp75/exp76a/exp76d. Round 18 already flagged these gaps (v_hyp_slots_28sep_r18s-3 fix (b)), but nobody acted on it by 18:13Z. CAVEATS: (1) The queue argument is partly overstated. exp71 training ended 13:25Z, so both lanes are mostly free. A dummy pushed right after 45's read (~19:15Z) still has ~4.5 h. The exp75 stall was per-kernel: later pushes (exp72, exp76d) ran first, so a multi-hour stall is possible for any file. Pushing early is a cheap hedge for exp76e and necessary for exp76c/g/exp73m, whose trigger (46) reads ~22:30Z-00:00Z. (2) Per PC19-02, 46 may not be terminal by 23:45Z, since its dummy ran +24%. The exp76c/g/exp73m dummies would then serve W2, not W1, which is still useful. (3) exp76c runtime: exp70q + CI. The CI deadline is KERNEL_START + 37800 s with a kill at +900 s, so L <= ~10.75 h, fail-soft. On a slower base, CI coverage may be partial; the dummy gate must read the mean COORDINJECT_WORKER s/video. (4) VALUE is public-only. cap6 lab -0.00057 (0 TP / 4 FP); thr 0.3 has no lab support; secFT and CI are in-sample labs. Private value is ~0 and none of these files is a finals input except under the card's (2) rules. (5) Quota: ~22 h were left at Q1; ~16 h remain after exp71 and ~6 dummies; 4 dummies cost ~2-2.5 GPU-h. (6) GPU contention with E10: a verbatim copy that triggers tonight would queue behind the speculative dummies. The R17-A4 rule that the copy goes first applies to the slot, not the queue.
fix: Build now into the final folders with the round-18 strings (round18/scan_hyp_slots_28sep.json build_env_git_bash). Use Git Bash with MSYS_NO_PATHCONV=1; the KQ order puts CAP/THRESH after LOWREFINE. Suggested names follow the exp76a/d style: exp76c_k2fm_maxdiv_ci, exp76e_k2fm_cap6, exp76g_k2fm_maxdiv_secft. Then: (a) Assert the cell diff against the repo base. exp76e vs exp70b_k2_fm45 (b8e7ece1): name + DIVINS_CAP 6 only. exp76g vs exp70q_k2_maxdiv (33ab04d1): name + SECONDARY_EXPECTED_SHA256 ed8c616b + manifest line + dataset biohub-secft-all-v1. exp76c vs exp70q: name + COORDINJECT_ENABLE/ALPHA + a CI cell identical to exp76a's + dataset yuki0731/biohub-coord-inject. Record the new shas in CONTEXT; they differ from the drafts because of the name. (b) Push the dummies speculatively as lanes free: exp76e, exp76c, exp76g, then exp73m (already built, sha 76c81122 reproduces; no dummy yet). If 45 has already read NEG or N4 when a lane frees, skip exp76e. If an E10 v3 trigger fires, its verbatim/SI dummy goes before any remaining speculative push. (c) Gates are the round-18 ones. For exp76c, also log the mean COORDINJECT_WORKER s/video and flag partial-coverage risk: base exp70q dummy 1,874 s vs K2 1,512 s; CI deadline 10.5 h from kernel start. Its ledger admission is L_hi <= 10.75 h. (d) Combine with PC19-02. If 46 is not terminal at the last header before 23:50Z, the exp76c/g/exp73m dummies serve W2 and W1 uses 45's row. (e) Log one CONTEXT line (build shas, push times) so the fallback chain in card (4) is auditable.
realistic_gain: Operational only: this keeps pre-registered W1/W2 rows executable instead of letting them silently collapse to the exp76a/exp72/exp75 fallbacks. By the round-18 priors, the chance that one of exp76c/e/g/exp73m is actually submitted in W1 is ~0.3. Given its branch, P(display >= 0.955) is ~0.5, i.e. roughly +0.001 public and +30-40 places in those branches. Expected private gain is ~0: the files are public-only rungs whose labs are flat or negative. Cost is ~2-2.5 GPU-h of ~16 h quota and some E10 queue contention.
